title: Machines Held Back From a Renew Business Asset Buyback Collection Run for a Protection Claim
content:
Machines whose protection cover is in question are held back from a collection run on a Renew Business Asset Buyback agreement, and how many they are is counted from the claim history of the plans the profile holds under Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans.

**How the count is taken.**

- Where the profile holds a protection plan and a claim was filed on it within the last three months, the machines held back are counted as the claims filed in those three months.
- Where the profile holds a protection plan and no claim was filed on it within the last three months but a claim was filed within the last twelve months, the machines held back are counted as the claims filed in those twelve months that carry no decision. That is the claims filed in the twelve months less the claim decisions recorded in the twelve months, and never fewer than none.
- Where the profile holds no protection plan, or no claim has been filed on one within the last twelve months, no machine is held back on that account.

**Basis questions.**

*Which window governs when claims sit in both?* The three-month window. A claim filed within the last three months puts the count on the first basis, and the twelve-month basis is reached only where the last three months carry no claim at all.

*Does a claim already decided still hold a machine back?* On the three-month basis every claim filed in those three months is counted, decided or not. On the twelve-month basis only the claims that carry no decision are counted, the decisions recorded in those twelve months being set against the claims filed in them.

*What if the profile holds no plan at all?* Then no machine is held back on this account, however many claims a plan once carried.

**Hypothetical illustrations.** A profile holding a Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans plan with 2 claims filed in the last three months holds 2 machines back. The same profile with no claim in the last three months, 5 claims filed in the last twelve months and 3 claim decisions recorded in the last twelve months holds 2 machines back. With 3 claims filed in the twelve months and 4 decisions recorded in them, the count does not fall below none, so no machine is held back.
